questions_and_answers.answer: Final Answer: The investment in the sorting machine has a positive Net Present Value (NPV) of approximately $57,902.23 when discounted at a 7% annual interest rate. Since this value exceeds the initial investment of $50,000, the investment is considered worthwhile. ; Explanation: To determine whether the investment in the sorting machine is worthwhile, we need to calculate the Net Present Value (NPV) of the expected returns and compare it to the initial investment. Here are the steps to follow: Calculate the Present Value of Future Returns: The formula to calculate the present value (PV) is: P V = ( 1 + r ) n C ​ where: C is the cash flow for each year (in this case, $7,500) r is the annual interest rate (7% or 0.07) n is the year number.
